beats.narration_text: Hallo — this is Liam, in for Komal. Madison weekly: the team locked scope with Nina, chose C V A T over building annotation from scratch, lined up three weeks of build work, kept collecting free images — and Komal opened a second track on brand frameworks for Madison tools.

beats.narration_text: First move this week: finalize the project scope, then turn it into milestones. That plan went to Nina, the supervisor — so everyone is looking at the same map before the build accelerates.

Before the timeline stuck, one alignment question. Option A: build an end-to-end tool — annotate, manage datasets, prep training data, detect wildlife. Option B: use an existing annotator like C V A T, and spend limited hands on models and the workflow gaps. Open source already does annotation well. The team had to pick.

beats.narration_text: Decision: Option B. C V A T owns annotation. The development team focuses on machine learning models and the rest of the workflow that does not already have a strong open-source answer. Building the whole platform from scratch is not the best use of limited hands right now.

beats.narration_text: With C V A T slotted in, the near plan stays. Week one: Lovable demo, GitHub repo, confirm the stack. Week two: scalable project structure and the design document. Week three: first core feature — likely frame extraction or frame annotation. Full project plan hardens once this scope stays locked.

beats.narration_text: In parallel, the team kept collecting more free-licensed images to help train the model. Provenance still matters — free is not the same as free-to-train without a trail.

Second track: Komal is drafting framework ideas for marketing and brand tools under Madison — Jungian archetypes, Big Five, M B T I, Enneagram; VALS, Maslow, diffusion; Aaker, StoryBrand, jobs to be done. Next Madison meeting picks a direction. Then she writes the detailed feature plan.

beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Scope and milestones went to Nina. The fork was build-everything versus borrow annotation. Option B won: C V A T plus models and workflow. Weeks one through three are queued. Images keep coming. Brand frameworks land next meeting. Design judgment: don't rebuild what C V A T already solved.
